The three-day district youth convention drew 2,300 participants from 14 blocks, against a target of 2,000. Day one featured a skills fair with 40 stalls run by local startups and training institutes; 620 participants registered for follow-up courses. Day two focused on civic participation, with mock parliament sessions and a debate on water conservation that was later shared widely on social media, reaching about 1.8 lakh views. Day three included a cultural evening and an awards ceremony recognising 25 youth volunteers. Feedback forms (1,150 responses) rated the event 4.3 out of 5, but many participants complained about long queues at registration and the lack of drinking water stations on day one. Organisers have proposed online pre-registration and doubling water points for next year.
